segments.he:
א.

כָּל הַמּוֹצִיא מַעַשְׂרוֹתָיו כָּרָאוּי, אֵינוֹ מַפְסִיד כְּלוּם.
segments.en: One who leaves the needs of the community and engages in his own needs, is as if he takes bribery.

segments.he:
ב.

תִּתְחַבֵּר לְמַצְלִיחַ וְתַצְלִיחַ.
segments.en: Through confession, one merits to superiority.

segments.he:
ג.

אֵין הַבְּרָכָה מְצוּיָה אֶלָּא בְּדָבָר הַסָּמוּי מִן הָעַיִן.
segments.en: Through the sanctity of the blessed G-d's name, the rule of the leaders of the generation has full power and might, and through this the  Mitzvah of hospitality is highly regarded in everyone's eyes, and through this those that study  (the Torah)  merit that the  H alacha (final legal ruling on a matter of the Torah)  is like them.

segments.he:
ד.

הַצְלָחָה – סִיַּעְתָּא דִשְׁמַיָּא הִיא.
segments.en: Anyone who gives his tithes properly does not lose anything  (to the tithing. t.n.) .

segments.he:
ה.

מִי שֶׁנִּפְסְקָה לוֹ הַהַצְלָחָה וְאֵינוֹ מַצְלִיחַ, לֹא בִּמְהֵרָה יַצְלִיחַ.
segments.en: Join a successful person, and you will be successful.

segments.he:
ו.

תֵּכֶף לְתַלְמִידֵי־חֲכָמִים בְּרָכָה בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיהֶם.
segments.en: Blessing abounds only on something that it is hidden from sight.

segments.he:
ז.

עֵסֶק הַתּוֹרָה הִיא סְגֻלָּה לְהַצְלָחָה.
segments.en: Success – assistance from Heaven brings it  (it is) .

segments.he:
ח.

מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְשַׁיֵּר פַּת עַל  שֻׁלְחָנוֹ, אֵינוֹ רוֹאֶה סִימ ָ ן בְּרָכָה לְעוֹלָם.
segments.en: Someone whose success has ceased and is not successful will not come to success quickly.

segments.he:
ט.

כֵּיוָן שֶׁלֹּא הִזְכִּיר אֶלָּא צַד אֶחָד הַטּוֹב וְלֹא הַהֵפֶךְ, אֵין זֶה נִחוּשׁ.
segments.en: Immediately after Torah scholars there is blessing in the work of their hands (t.n. Rashi in tractate Brachos explains this to mean someone who befriends a Torah scholar or hosts him will immediately afterwards have blessing in the work of their hands. t.n. See also #16) .

segments.he:
י.

בַּיִת, תִּינוֹק ,  וְאִשָּׁה ,  הֵם סִימָן לְהַצְלָחָה.
segments.en: Engagement in Torah is a  segulah for success.

segments.he:
יא.

מִי שֶׁמְּגָרֵשׁ אֶת אִשְׁתּוֹ, אֵינוֹ מַצְלִיחַ.
segments.en: Someone who does not leave over bread on his table never sees the sign of blessing.

segments.he:
יב.

מִי שֶׁהַשָּׁעָה מַצְלַחַת לוֹ, לִבּוֹ רָם עָלָיו גַּם אֵימָתוֹ מֻטֶּלֶת עַל הַבְּרִיּוֹת.
segments.en: Since he only mentioned the one good side and not the reverse, this is not considered divining (t.n. The Torah forbids one to make readings of occurrences to decide what the future holds and how to proceed, whether or not to do something or in which direction to go. However one is permitted to make for himself a one sided sign of success, that such and such an occurrence will be a sign of success) .

segments.he:
יג.

מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מְדַבֵּר דְּבָרִים בְּטֵלִים, מַצְלִיחַ בְּכָל מַעֲשָׂיו.
segments.en: A house, child, and wife are omens for success.

segments.he:
יד.

מִי שֶׁאוֹמֵר תָּמִיד אֱמֶת, הוּא מַצְלִיחַ.
segments.en: Someone who divorces his wife will not be successful.

segments.he:
טו.

עַל־יְדֵי וִדּוּי תַּצְלִיחַ.
segments.en: Someone whom the hour is fortunate for him, his heart is exalted, also the fear of him is cast on everyone  (lit. all creatures).

segments.he:
טז.

הַצְלָחָה בָּא, לְמִי שֶׁמַּאֲכִיל תַּלְמִיד־חָכָם עַל שֻׁלְחָנוֹ.
segments.en: Someone who does not speak unnecessary words is successful in everything he does.

segments.he:
יז.

כְּשֶׁאֵין לְךָ אֱמֶת, אֲזַי נִטָּל מִמְּךָ הַהַצְלָחָה וְנִתָּן לָאֻמּוֹת.
segments.en: Someone who always speaks the truth, he is successful.

segments.he:
יח.

לְהַצְלָחָה תִּשְׁמַע כְּשֶׁהַצַּדִּיק אוֹמֵר יִחוּד הַשֵּׁם, הַיְנוּ שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל.
segments.en: Through confession, you will be successful.

segments.he:
יט.

עַל־יְדֵי אֱמוּנַת חֲכָמִים בָּא הַצְלָחָה.
segments.en: Success comes to one who feeds a Torah scholar on his table.

segments.he:
כ.

חֵלֶק שֵׁנִי
segments.en: When you do not have truth, success is taken from you and given to the gentiles  (lit. the nations).

segments.he:
כא.

מִי שֶׁהוּא שָׂמֵחַ תָּמִיד, עַל־יְדֵי זֶה הוּא מַצְלִיחַ.

כב.

צָרִיךְ לְכַבֵּד לָזֶה שֶׁהַשָּׁעָה מְשַׂחֶקֶת לוֹ.

כג.

מִי שֶׁהוּא מֻצְלָח, הַזְּמַן בְּיָדוֹ.
